name: 赛博朋克
description: 霓虹都市 · 雨夜街角 · 写实 CG / 电影级渲染

lighting.label: 霓虹冷调
lighting.promptEn: saturated neon-lit cool atmosphere, vivid cyan and magenta key lights bleeding into deep cobalt shadows, volumetric god rays through humid air, cinematic color grading reminiscent of Blade Runner 2049

lighting.label: 雨夜反光
lighting.promptEn: torrential rainy night, wet asphalt glistening with mirror-like neon reflections, individual falling raindrops catching the highlights, dense atmospheric fog, photographed in the style of Blade Runner 2049 directed by Denis Villeneuve, cinematography by Roger Deakins

lighting.label: 雾巷暖光
lighting.promptEn: narrow smoky alleyway lit by warm amber and sodium-pink neon, thick steam curling from grates, dust particles dancing in shafts of light, color palette inspired by Cyberpunk 2077 night city, cinematic chiaroscuro

lighting.label: 末日黎明
lighting.promptEn: polluted post-apocalyptic dawn, sickly yellow-orange sun barely piercing through smog and acid rain, deep blue-grey shadows, high dynamic range, lighting style reminiscent of Ghost in the Shell (2017) and Children of Men

lighting.label: 黑红警戒
lighting.promptEn: high-contrast hazard lighting, deep crimson red key light against absolute black shadows, emergency strobes, oppressive atmosphere, lighting reference: Aliens by James Cameron and the Resident Evil films

promptTemplate:
{refImageHint}A photorealistic cinematic {tilt}, captured at {focalLength}mm focal length on a full-frame cinema camera (Arri Alexa LF or RED Komodo){areaSegment}. The scene is set in a vast cyberpunk megacity inspired by the visual language of Blade Runner 2049, Cyberpunk 2077 and Ghost in the Shell. 

Lighting and atmosphere: {lighting}. 

Foreground details: {front}. 

Mid-ground action: {middle}. 

Background and skyline: {back}. 

Rendering style: hyperrealistic CG render, Unreal Engine 5 with Lumen and Nanite, ray-traced reflections and global illumination, physically-based materials, subsurface scattering on translucent surfaces, volumetric atmospheric haze with light shafts, cinematic anamorphic lens flares, shallow depth of field with bokeh, ISO 800 film grain, slight chromatic aberration at the edges, color graded for cinema (high contrast, teal-orange palette tweaked for neon), 8K resolution, ultra-detailed textures, award-winning concept art quality, trending on ArtStation.
negativePrompt: blurry, low resolution, low quality, jpeg artifacts, watermark, signature, text artifacts, anime cartoon flat shading, oversaturated cartoon style, distorted faces, extra limbs, deformed anatomy, low-poly, plastic-looking skin, amateur photo, smartphone snapshot, harsh on-camera flash

refImageHints.withRef: The exact person from the reference image is naturally composited into the scene as the central subject, preserving their facial identity, body proportions, clothing and pose. Match the camera angle, lighting direction and depth shown by the reference. The person is fully integrated into the cyberpunk environment with consistent shadows, ambient color bounce from neon, and atmospheric haze.
